name_zh: 杜福尔/瑞士/联邦/红十字/军队/内战/宪法/中立/人道
description_zh: 雅克·杜福尔（1787-1875），瑞士军官，瑞士联邦上校，领导瑞士内战（1847年），统一瑞士联邦，建立瑞士国，发起红十字会国际委员会（ICRC）的创立，倡导中立和人道主义，瑞士建国元勋。
description_en: Jacques Dufour (1787-1875), Swiss military officer, Swiss Federal Colonel, led Swiss Civil War (1847), unified Swiss Confederation, established Swiss nation, initiated founding of International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), advocated neutrality and humanitarianism, Swiss nation founder.
reason_zh: 杜福尔是瑞士建国元勋，领导统一瑞士联邦，建立瑞士国，发起红十字会国际委员会的创立，其联邦主义思想和人道主义精神对瑞士国家身份和国际人道主义法产生深远影响。
reason_en: Dufour was Swiss nation founder, led unified Swiss Confederation, established Swiss nation, initiated founding of International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), his federalism thinking and humanitarian spirit profoundly influenced Swiss national identity and international humanitarian law.
expected_zh: 建立瑞士联邦国家，领导统一瑞士，发起红十字会国际委员会的创立，倡导中立和人道主义，对瑞士国家身份和国际人道主义法产生深远影响。
expected_en: Established Swiss federal nation, led unified Switzerland, initiated founding of International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), advocated neutrality and humanitarianism, profoundly influenced Swiss national identity and international humanitarian law.
